rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: フォーティチュード・リー

relations.text: 2025年7月、長期介護保険の一部をFortitude Reに出再する取引を完了
relations.text_en: Closed a reinsurance deal ceding part of its long-term care book to Fortitude Re in July 2025

source.label: Unum 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In February 2025, Unum America entered into a master transaction agreement with Fortitude Re, resulting in the execution of a coinsurance agreement (reinsurance agreement) in July 2025.

companies.name: コモンウェルス・アニュイティ

relations.text: 個人向け就業不能保険の旧契約の大半を、2020〜21年にCommonwealthへ再保険で移した
relations.text_en: Moved most of its closed block individual disability business to Commonwealth through reinsurance in 2020-21

source.label: Unum 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We exited a substantial portion of our Closed Block individual disability product line through two phases of a coinsurance and modified coinsurance reinsurance transaction with Commonwealth Annuity and Life Insurance Company (Commonwealth) that were executed in December 2020 and March 2021.

companies.name: ボヤ・ファイナンシャル

relations.text: Voyaが10-Kで、補完給付(職域保険)市場の競合としてUnumを挙げる
relations.text_en: Voya names Unum as a competitor in supplemental benefits

source.label: Voya Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Supplemental Benefits Market is growing rapidly. Competitive drivers are price, claim servicing and product innovation. Cigna Aetna Aflac MetLife Unum

relations.text: CNOが10-Kで、職域向け補完医療保険の主な競合としてUnumの子会社を挙げる
relations.text_en: CNO names Unum subsidiaries among main competitors for worksite supplemental health

source.label: CNO Financial 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our main competitors for supplemental health products sold through our Worksite Division include AFLAC, subsidiaries of Unum, MetLife, Chubb/Combined, and Voya.

relations.text: Horace Mannが10-Kで、従業員向け給付保険の競合としてUnum傘下のColonialを挙げる
relations.text_en: Horace Mann names Unum's Colonial among competitors in employee benefit products

source.label: Horace Mann 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: including Aflac, American Fidelity, Colonial (a subsidiary of Unum)

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
